Chapter 15: The Ongoing Journey of Becoming Love
Becoming love isn’t really about reaching some final destination. It's more like a lifelong journey—one that’s full of twists, turns, and days when it just feels impossible. You’ll have setbacks, disappointments, and moments when you wonder if it’s even worth trying. But every single moment is a new invitation. You get to begin again, to choose love, and to trust—deep down—that it actually matters.
I remember hearing about a man who really struggled to forgive himself for things he’d done in the past. He wanted to live with love, but shame kept holding him back. Over time, and with the support of friends and a little faith, he learned how to show himself grace. That’s when he realized something powerful: becoming love starts with how you treat yourself. You’ve got to offer yourself the same kindness, patience, and forgiveness you hope to give others.
Most of us don’t even notice how much we need grace. It’s so easy to be tough on yourself—to focus on your failures or the things you wish you’d done differently. But real love begins with acceptance. With being willing to see yourself as worthy and lovable, just as you are right now.
There’s something a community leader once said that really stuck with me: “We’re all just learning how to love.” That simple truth is a gentle reminder—nobody has it all figured out. This journey is ongoing. It’s full of ups and downs, sure, but also these beautiful moments of connection, hope, and growth.
So what does it mean to become love? It’s about showing up—again and again—even when it’s tough. It’s believing that every effort, no matter how small, actually counts. Every act of kindness matters, even if nobody notices at first.
You might not realize just how much you’re capable of, or how much the world truly needs what you have to offer. But little by little, this journey shapes more than just the world around you—it changes your own heart in the process.
